item.text:
**5B.2 Verdict**
- **Mixed, leaning yes on appointments and only partly on empowerment.** Sharif did bring in a genuinely competent technocrat for finance and created technocratic advisory structures, but he also kept the PM’s office tightly in control, retained the old political guard in key posts, and mixed in business figures with potential conflicts.

**Evidence**

- **Pakistan PM to choose banker Aurangzeb as finance minister, sources say** | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-03-11 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/pakistan-pm-to-choose-banker-aurangzeb-as-finance-minister-sources-say/1996592/)  
  Sharif picked Muhammad Aurangzeb, a career banker and HBL chief, over veterans such as Ishaq Dar to run finance. That is strong evidence for choosing a competent economic professional rather than a loyalist placeholder.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- **Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb profile** | Government of Pakistan, Finance Division | 2024-03 | [URL](https://finance.gov.pk/profile_minister.html)  
  The finance ministry’s own profile says Aurangzeb is a longtime international banker and that his mandate is sustainable macro stability and prudent, transparent public financial management. This supports the competence/readiness side.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- **Finance czar commits to continuing caretakers’ policies** | Dawn | 2024-03-12 | [URL](https://www.dawn.com/news/1820907)  
  Aurangzeb publicly framed his task as implementation and IMF reform rather than politics, which is consistent with empowering a professional to run the economic portfolio.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- **PM forms economic advisory council without Dar, Aurangzeb** | The News | 2024-05-19 | [URL](https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1190715-pm-forms-new-economic-advisory-council-without-dar-aurangzeb)  
  Sharif created a high-powered Economic Advisory Council filled with economists, technocrats, and business figures, explicitly for policy guidance. That is positive on bringing expertise into the process, though not purely technocratic.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- **PM-led economic advisory council constituted** | Business Recorder | 2024-05-19 | [URL](https://www.brecorder.com/news/40304146)  
  The EAC was chaired by the prime minister and included economists and business figures. This shows Sharif did seek expert advice, but the structure remained PM-led rather than independent.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- **PM relieves finance minister from key economic forum** | Dawn | 2024-06-15 | [URL](https://www.dawn.com/news/1839967)  
  Sharif personally took charge of ECNEC instead of letting finance minister Aurangzeb chair it, which is evidence against fully empowering the technocrat.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- **New blood joins old guard in federal cabinet** | Dawn | 2024-03-12 | [URL](https://www.dawn.com/news/amp/1820930)  
  The cabinet mixed a new finance technocrat with old-guard figures such as Ishaq Dar and Attaullah Tarar. That cuts against a clean break from loyalists, even if the finance portfolio itself went to a professional outsider.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.8`

- **Who are the members of PM Sharif’s new cabinet?** | Arab News PK | 2024-03-12 | [URL](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2474906/pakistan)  
  This roundup describes the cabinet as including Sharif-family loyalists alongside veteran politicians and former ministers. That is the main counterevidence to a pure technocratic reading.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- **Pakistan PM Sharif picks prominent banker in new cabinet, document shows** | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-03-11 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/pakistan-pm-sharif-picks-prominent-banker-in-new-cabinet-document-shows/1996146/)  
  Reuters described Aurangzeb as a bank CEO brought into cabinet, but the story also notes the decision came from Sharif’s office. This supports competence, but also shows it was a top-down appointment rather than delegation to an autonomous economic team.  
  IDs: `5B.2`

- **PM forms Economic Advisory Council for policy guidance** | Profit by Pakistan Today | 2024-05-18 | [URL](https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2024/05/18/pm-forms-economic-advisory-council-for-policy-guidance)  
  The EAC was explicitly created to provide “the best possible professional advice” on economic policy. That supports the claim that Sharif sought expertise, though the council’s PM chairmanship still limited independence.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, `5B.1`

**Search gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Sharif appointed family members or business partners to the core federal economic ministries.
- The strongest negative evidence is structural: he kept the PM’s office central, retained old-guard figures like Ishaq Dar in senior roles, and used advisory bodies that mixed technocrats with business magnates rather than fully independent professionals.
